report: Findings: There is a mild knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning of the medial patellar facet articular cartilage but no cartilage loss. The remaining patellofemoral articulation is normal.  Some altered bone marrow signal is noted in the tibial spine region deep to the ACL attachment. No sinister pathology. The visualized bones are otherwise unremarkable.  Conclusion: Mild patellar chondromalacia. No meniscal tears.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs grade II dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Medial menisküs posterior horn ve gövde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Arka , ön çapraz bağlar , lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar ve trohlear kartilajda kondromalazi izlendi.Patellofemoral eklem lateral düzeyinde komşu kemik yapılarda subkondral kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik kistler izlendi. Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda hafif osteofitik sivrileşmeler izlenmektedir. Tibia interkondiler tüberkül düzeyinde ön çapraz ve arka çapraz bağ yapışma düzeylerinde milimetrik subkondral kistler izlenmektedir.Lateral fossa medial düzeyde vastus medialis kası tendon komşuluğunda 20x6 mm boyutlarında ganglion kist ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.

The ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL complex are intact The medial and lateral menisci are intact 
  
 The quadriceps tendon and the patellar tendon are intact The patella is normally located in the femoral groove. 
  
 Joint effusion and fluid in the suprapatellar bursa are 1. Suprapatellar plicae are seen. Suspect few lipomatous proliferation of the synovium in the lateral aspect of the suprapatellar bursa. 
  
 Multiple osteophytes are seen. Thinning and irregularity of articular cartilages are detected in the patellofemoral and bilateral tibiofemoral compartments. The cartilage loss is most severe in the medial tibiofemoral compartment, where there is more than 50% cartilage loss. 
  
 No Baker's cyst or other spaceoccupying soft tissue lesion is shown. A small cyst is seen at the proximal tibia. No suspicious bone lesion, gross fracture, or bone contusion is shown.  No significant ligament or meniscus injury 
  Joint effusion and fluid in suprapatellar bursa with suspected lipoma arborescens in the lateral aspect of the suprapatellar fossa 
  Osteoarthritis of the left knee joint with multifocal chondromalacia, up to grade III. 
  A benignlooking cyst at the proximal tibia; probably an intraosseous ganglion/synovial cyst.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Luxación de patela izquierda reciente. Obs. Lesión meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial que podría representar una
pequeña rotura periférica.
Rotura compleja de la raíz meniscal posterior, cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco lateral con
segmento parcialmente desplazado hacia la región intercondílea posterior. Esto se asocia a edema las
partes blandas regionales y a edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral lateral con pequeña fractura
subcortical regional. No hay signos de colapso articular. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula
ósea. No se observan lesiones condrales significativas de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Úlceras
condrales superficiales de la tróclea femoral. Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos
secundarios de la faceta medial y vértice de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del tendón
rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral,
probablemente reactivo.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco lateral con segmento desplazado hacia la región intercondílea posterior. Esto
se asocia discreto edema las partes blandas regionales con edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral
lateral y pequeña fractura subcortical regional.
Signos de una rotura del menisco medial, no desplazada.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la rótula. Condropatía troclear superficial.
Leve derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Condromalacia.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Meniscos de morfología y señal normal, sin criterios de rotura.
Cartílago de los compartimentos femorotibiales de espesor y señal conservados.
Cartílago patelofemoral de espesor conservado con alteración difusa de señal intrasustancia, sin
defectos condrales profundos.
Leve alteración de señal de las fibras laterales proximales del tendón rotuliano.
Restantes tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
No hay derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker.
Discreto edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados.
Impresión:
Condropatía patelofemoral superficial intrasustancia.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría
representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano

МР находка: Няма МР  данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма и структура, с наличие на субкортикални костни кисти геоди в областта на преднолатералния ръб на медиалния кондил на фемура. Ставният хрущял предимно на фемура и в по-слаба степен на тибията е изтънен от медиалната страна на ставата. Дегенеративни промени в двата рога на латералния менискус.  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Същата е задебелена, с кос ход и с хиперинтензитет на сигнала, като достига до артикулиращия хрущял на тибията. Увредата съответства на руптура 3-та степен. По съседство с нея се изобразява менискална киста с размер около 4мм. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Патела, лигамент и хрущял на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти и ретинакулуми - б.о. Нормално изобразяване на скенирните мускулни групи и меки тъкани. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Дегенеративни промени в двата рога на латералния менискус. Изтънен ставен хрущял на тибията и фемура от към медиално.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Chronic left knee pain with ambulation.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus shows a tiny nondisplaced partial radial tear involving the posterior horn, without meniscal extrusion. The posterior root, body, and anterior horn of the medial meniscus are intact. This tear was not shown on the previous MRI from <[YEAR]>.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No patellofemoral subluxation. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 11 mm, within normal limits.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Mild chondrosis overlying the lateral patellar facet, also shown previously without imaging progression. There is subtle chondral fibrillation at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment, progressed since <[YEAR]>. There is focal high-grade cartilage thinning involving the anterior peripheral aspect of the medial femoral condyle, new since previous study. Within the lateral compartment, there is fissuring of articular cartilage involving the central posterior weightbearing aspect lateral femoral condyle, new/progressed from <[YEAR]>.

Trace knee joint fluid. Baker's cyst, measuring 31 x 11 x 49 mm. No discrete 10 mm chondral fragment is seen within the cyst, which is increased in size compared to previous.

Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Interval development of tiny, partial nondisplaced radial tear involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. No meniscal extrusion.
2. Progressive mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis, consistent with progressive mild tricompartment osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. 31 x 11 x 49 mm Baker's cyst containing a 10 mm chondral fragment.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is an undisplaced horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. No evidence of ligamentous rupture. Moderate soft tissue edema is noted along the medial aspect of the knee.  Moderate thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted. There is also mild - moderate thinning of the patellar articular cartilage. Normal trochlear and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Mild - moderate thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage. Soft tissue edema is noted surrounding the medial aspect of the knee and MCL. No evidence of MCL injury.
